subheaders.name: numwins
subheaders.label: W-L
subheaders.description: Won Games

subheaders.name: fpi
subheaders.label: FPI
subheaders.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

subheaders.name: fpirank
subheaders.label: RK
subheaders.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

subheaders.name: rankchange7days
subheaders.label: TREND
subheaders.description: FPI Rank change from previous week.

subheaders.name: projectedw
subheaders.label: PROJ W-L
subheaders.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

subheaders.name: probwinout
subheaders.label: WIN OUT%
subheaders.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

subheaders.name: prob6wins
subheaders.label: 6WINS%
subheaders.description: Percent of season simulations in which a team won at least 6 games (typically bowl-eligible).

subheaders.name: probwindiv
subheaders.label: WIN DIV%
subheaders.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference division, for those conferences that have divisions.

subheaders.name: probwinconf
subheaders.label: WIN CONF%
subheaders.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference, incorporating chance of getting to and winning conference championship game (if applicable). Accounts for shared conference titles in conferences that allow them.

subheaders.name: probmakeplayoffs
subheaders.label: PLAYOFF%
subheaders.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff, according to the Playoff Predictor.

subheaders.name: probmaketitlegame
subheaders.label: MAKE NC%
subheaders.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff National Championship game, according to the Playoff Predictor.

subheaders.name: probwintitle
subheaders.label: WIN NC%
subheaders.description: Chance to win the CFB Playoff National Championship, according to the Playoff Predictor.

subheaders.name: accomplishmentrank
subheaders.label: SOR
subheaders.description: Strength of Record rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

subheaders.name: fpirank
subheaders.label: FPI
subheaders.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

subheaders.name: avgsosrank
subheaders.label: SOS
subheaders.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average Top 25 team.

subheaders.name: sosremainingrank
subheaders.label: REM SOS
subheaders.description: Rank among all FBS teams of remaining schedule strength, from perspective of an average FBS team.

subheaders.name: gamecontrolrank
subheaders.label: GC
subheaders.description: Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

subheaders.name: avgingamewprank
subheaders.label: AVGWP
subheaders.description: Team's average in-game win probability rank adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

subheaders.name: totefficiency
subheaders.label: EFF
subheaders.description: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.

subheaders.name: totefficiencyrank
subheaders.label: RNK
subheaders.description: Team's overall efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

subheaders.name: offefficiency
subheaders.label: EFF
subheaders.description: Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.

subheaders.name: offefficiencyrank
subheaders.label: RNK
subheaders.description: Team's offensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

subheaders.name: defefficiency
subheaders.label: EFF
subheaders.description: Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.

subheaders.name: defefficiencyrank
subheaders.label: RNK
subheaders.description: Team's defensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

subheaders.name: stefficiency
subheaders.label: EFF
subheaders.description: Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.

subheaders.name: stefficiencyrank
subheaders.label: RNK
subheaders.description: Team's special teams efficiency rank among all FBS teams.
